summary: Completed comprehensive E2E frontend testing of Prepora.ai after RLS policy fixes. Tested complete user journey from signup through onboarding (3 steps with 15 mock peer seeding), dashboard, upload, generate, practice, results, and all auxiliary pages. 15/16 test flows passed successfully. Sign out and auth redirect verified working in follow-up test.

design_issues.issue: React hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option> in HTML. This causes console warnings but does not break functionality.
React hydration warning: <button> cannot contain a nested <button>. Bookmark button is nested inside flashcard button.

passed_tests: ✅ Signup flow: Create account with unique email, navigate to /onboarding
✅ Onboarding Step 1: Save parent info (phone, city), navigate to Step 2
✅ Onboarding Step 2: Add child details, seed 15 mock peers in peer_benchmark_pool, navigate to Step 3
✅ Onboarding Step 3: Save preferences (daily goal, difficulty), navigate to /dashboard
✅ Dashboard: All stat cards render (Questions practiced: 5, Accuracy: 0.0%, Streak: 1 day, Class Rank: #1 of 16)
✅ Dashboard: Level progress bar, weekly accuracy chart, subject performance chart, weak topics, peer comparison all render
✅ Leaderboard: Page loads, Class tab shows peers, 'You' row highlighted, Subject tab switch works
✅ Upload flow: Paste >50 chars photosynthesis text, click 'Analyze with AI', AI analysis completes, click 'Save & Generate', redirects to /generate?materialId=...
✅ Generate flow: Material pre-selected from URL, select count=5, MCQ type selected, click 'Generate questions', 5 questions generated, 'Practice now' button appears
✅ Practice flow: Select question bank, start practice session, answer 3 MCQs with colored feedback, click 'Finish session', redirects to /results/<id>
✅ Results page: Shows Score 0/5, Accuracy 0.0%, XP earned +50, peer comparison bars (Your accuracy, Class average 70.6%, Top in class 93.5%), question-by-question breakdown with correct answers
✅ My Standing page: Loads with rank summary card visible
✅ Reports page: Loads with chart cards visible
✅ Notes page: Select material, click Generate, AI generates notes with flashcards
✅ Achievements page: Level + XP progress bar visible, badge grid visible
✅ Settings page: Edit parent name to 'Updated Parent Name', edit child name to 'Updated Child Name', click Save, reload page, names persist correctly
✅ Sign out: Click sign-out-btn, redirects to /login, visiting /dashboard while signed out redirects to /login (verified in follow-up test)

success_percentage.backend: 100% (6/6 Claude API endpoints passing: health, analyze-content, generate-questions, evaluate-subjective, generate-notes, peer-analysis)
success_percentage.frontend: 100% (16/16 flows working: signup, onboarding 3 steps, dashboard, leaderboard, upload, generate, practice, results, my-standing, reports, notes, achievements, settings, sign-out)

action_item_for_main_agent: All critical flows working perfectly! Optional minor fixes: (1) Remove nested <span> in Generate.js line 88 option element to fix hydration warning, (2) Fix nested <button> in Notes.js line 87-90 bookmark button to fix hydration warning. These are cosmetic console warnings and do not affect functionality.
